verdict.rationale: BigQuery's documented sandbox lets users try BigQuery without a credit card or billing account, and the docs state it exists to explore the product at no cost and confirm fit. A standing free tier of 10 GiB storage and 1 TiB of queries per month supports running real queries, and BigQuery sharing exposes curated Google and third-party datasets to query. Missing for 10: the docs only say the sandbox offers 'limited capabilities' without spelling out the limits, and no independent or hands-on report confirms the no-card sandbox experience.
